nodes.name: 01-research-paper-plan.md
nodes.summary: Pre-registration and manuscript blueprint for MMseqs2-Triton, proposing portable fused Triton implementations of the gapless filter and Smith–Waterman–Gotoh alignment. It defines four falsifiable hypotheses, kernel designs, baselines, cross-vendor experiments, correctness gates, success criteria, limitations, and the path from measured results to a Bioinformatics submission.
nodes.languageNotes: The Markdown is organized like a prospective scientific manuscript, with equations, benchmark matrices, phased methods, and hypotheses replacing unmeasured results.

nodes.name: 02-experimental-protocol.md
nodes.summary: Operational runbook for executing the MMseqs2-Triton study across NVIDIA and AMD systems. It specifies environment capture, dataset acquisition, baseline commands, phase gates, performance and correctness measurements, ablation sweeps, statistical analysis, and the results-to-manuscript handoff.
nodes.languageNotes: The document combines executable command sketches, checkbox-based gates, and empty results tables so experiments can be run and recorded consistently.

nodes.name: 03-target-venues.md
nodes.summary: Time-bounded workshop submission strategy for the MMseqs2-Triton paper, prioritizing NeurIPS 2026 MLSB and evaluating alternative AI-for-science and systems workshops. It records venue-fit reasoning, exclusions, estimated deadlines, an action calendar, and primary-source links.
